title: Spiritual Blessings in Christ, Thanksgiving and Prayer

questions.question: Paul writes to the saints who are in Ephesus, and who are ____ in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, To the saints who are in Ephesus, and are faithful in Christ Jesus:"

questions.question: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every ____ blessing in the heavenly places.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:3 (ESV): "Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places,"

questions.question: God chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be ____ and blameless before him.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:4 (ESV): "even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and blameless before him. In love"

questions.question: In love he predestined us for ____ to himself as sons through Jesus Christ, according to the purpose of his will,
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:5 (ESV): "he predestined us for adoption to himself as sons through Jesus Christ, according to the purpose of his will,"

questions.question: In him we have redemption through his ____, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:7 (ESV): "In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,"

questions.question: God made known to us the ____ of his will, according to his purpose, which he set forth in Christ.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:9 (ESV): "making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his purpose, which he set forth in Christ"

questions.question: What is the plan for the fullness of time? To unite all things in ____, things in heaven and things on earth.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:10 (ESV): "as a plan for the fullness of time, to unite all things in him, things in heaven and things on earth."

questions.question: In him we have obtained an ____, having been predestined according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his will.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:11 (ESV): "In him we have obtained an inheritance, having been predestined according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his will,"

questions.question: In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and believed in him, were ____ with the promised Holy Spirit.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:13 (ESV): "In him you also, when you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation, and believed in him, were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: The Holy Spirit is the ____ of our inheritance until we acquire possession of it, to the praise of his glory.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:14 (ESV): "who is the guarantee of our inheritance until we acquire possession of it, to the praise of his glory." (Note: some versions say earnest or pledge, ESV says guarantee).

questions.question: Because Paul heard of their faith and love, he ceases not to give thanks for them, remembering them in his prayers, that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ may give them the Spirit of ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:17 (ESV): "that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give you the Spirit of wisdom and of revelation in the knowledge of him,"

questions.question: He prays that having the eyes of their ____ enlightened, they may know the hope to which he has called them.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:18 (ESV): "having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope to which he has called you..."

questions.question: He also prays they may know the immeasurable greatness of his ____ toward us who believe, according to the working of his great might.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:19 (ESV): "and what is the immeasurable greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his great might"

questions.question: God raised Christ from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places, far above all ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:20-21 (ESV): "that he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and seated him at his right hand in the heavenly places, far above all rule and authority and power and dominion..."

questions.question: God put all things under Christ's feet and gave him as ____ over all things to the church, which is his ____.
questions.explanation: Ephesians 1:22-23 (ESV): "And he put all things under his feet and gave him as head over all things to the church, which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all."

key_verse_text: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us in Christ with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places,
